svg.title: The Hexwarden, phase 3 of 3: wrath
svg.desc: The Hexwarden in phase 3, wrath, for levels 7 to 9. Twenty-three eyes blaze, with new eyes open on his horns and forearms; his rage core bursts with rays, his horns crack with light and a ring of shards surrounds him. Two plates are shattered and reforming, two are cracked, and four solid beams lock onto the player's integrity check. He says: every patch you make, I unmake. Rage 8 of 9.
